Credit‑card 20 % | 70 % QR, 60 % bank‑transfer, 30 % mobile‑money in Brazil | 50 % households share 2–4‑seat families | Tax on data services, local “subscription tax” in some markets | **Key Take‑aways** * Pay‑rail heterogeneity is the single largest obstacle to a one‑size‑fits‑all USD price. * Across all growth markets, *family‑sharing* is a competitive lever — 60‑70 % of new households will expect at least a 2‑seat licence. * Low‑income segments rely on **pay‑as‑you‑go / instalment** and **mobile‑money**; they are highly price‑elastic. * High‑income segments (5–10 %) tolerate slightly premium pricing for **ad‑free** or **exclusive content** bundles. --- ## 2. Core Pricing Principles | Principle | Why It Matters | How We’ll Apply It | |-----------|----------------|--------------------| | **Value‑Based Local Anchoring** | Protects share‑of‑wallet while normalising consumer perception | Set a “base” price per region in local currency (LCR) that corresponds to the *median* willingness‑to‑pay (WTP) for a comparable streaming experience | Baseline: ~$3–$5 LCR for “Standard” stream | | **Dynamic Tiering & Bundling** | Encourages upsell from low to high‑income segments and deepens household penetration | Offer 3 core tiers (Standard, Premium + Ad‑free, Family‑Pack) and regional “mini‑bundles” (e.g., 4‑seat family) | Adjust tier mix per census | | **Localized Billing Flexibility** | Aligns with payment‑rail preferences and reduces friction | • Daily/weekly/monthly plans,
• “Instalment‑free” 4‑week auto‑charge,
• “QR‑one‑click” renewal | Provide 2‑step or 3‑step checkout based on locale | | **Controlled Sharing Caps** | Maintains “unit economics” while supporting household sharing | Allow 1–4 seats per household, enforce via device‑token + IP‑whitelist, impose 15‑min “cool‑down” for new user sign‑ups | Hard‑limit prevents fraud | | **Transparent Global Consolidation** | Investors need a single USD metric | Use *local currency‑to‑USD* conversion at the *month‑end* FX rate *plus* a 2 % hedging buffer to account for volatility | ARPU, LTV, CAC reported in USD, but discount factor reflects local pricing strategy | --- ## 3. Tier & Feature Architecture | Tier | Price (LCR) | Core Features | Family Seats | Payment Methods | |------|-------------|---------------|--------------|----------------| | **Standard** | $2–$5 LCR | HD video, 1‑seat, 1‑device, ads | 1 seat | Mobile‑money, QR, UPI/QR, 30‑day instalment | | **Premium** | $4–$8 LCR | 4K/HD, 1‑seat, 1‑device, ad‑free | 1 seat | Credit‑card, debit‑card, mobile‑money, QR, 2‑week instalment | | **Family Pack** | $6–$12 LCR (per 4‑seat) | All Premium + 4 seats, 4‑device, 1‑hour “family‑library” | 4 seats | All above, plus “family‑wallet” (shared payment) | | **Ad‑free Add‑on** | +$1–$2 LCR | Remove ads from Standard | — | — | | **Kids‑Only** | $0.5–$1 LCR | Simplified UI, curated children’s library | 1 seat | Mobile‑money | **Regional Price Rationale – Example** | Region | Standard Price | Premium Price | Family Pack Price | |--------|----------------|---------------|-------------------| | Africa | $2 LCR (≈$0.30 USD) | $4 LCR | $8 LCR | | South Asia | $3 LCR | $6 LCR | $12 LCR | | Latin America | $4 LCR | $8 LCR | $16 LCR | > These figures align with local disposable‑income curves and competing OTT services. *Price elasticity estimates*: 40 % lower‑income segments shift to Standard, 25 % to Family Pack, 35 % stay in Premium. --- ## 4. Payment‑Rail & Billing Flow | Customer Journey | Step | Action | Key Feature | |-------------------|------|--------|-------------| | **Signup** | 1 | Choose Tier (local UI) | 1‑click tier selector | | **Billing Setup** | 2 | Choose Pay‑rail | *If mobile‑money*: QR‑only; *if UPI/QRA*: embed gateway | | **Installment Option** | 3 | Offer “4‑week spread” for $5+ tiers | Automatic auto‑debit each week | | **Renewal** | 4 | 3‑step renewal: 1‑day reminder, 48 h last‑call, auto‑charge | “Pay‑as‑you‑go” fallback if auto‑fail | | **Wallet Sharing** | 5 | Family Pack: shared wallet + 2‑factor token | Family‑wallet auto‑top‑up via mobile‑money | ### 4.1 Regional Payment Nuances | Region | Best‑Practice Pay‑rail | Technical Requirement | Fraud Mitigation | |--------|------------------------|------------------------|------------------| | Africa | M‑Pesa + QR | 2‑Step OTP via SMS for new accounts | Micro‑transaction “capping” | | South Asia | UPI + QR | “One‑click” UPI authentication | Device MAC‑token | | Latin America | QR + Bank‑transfer | 2‑FA: card‑present | “Know‑Your‑Customer” check via local regulator APIs | > *All payment flows must support immediate “refund‑free” cancellation to preserve trust.* --- ## 5. Family‑Sharing & Household Monetisation | Feature | Description | Implementation Notes | |---------|-------------|----------------------| | **Multi‑Seat Subscription** | Allows 1–4 authenticated devices within same household | Device‑token + user‑email verification; IP whitelist | | **Family‑Library** | Shared, time‑based “family‑library” for group watching | Access via QR code; 5‑minute “group queue” | | **Seat‑Based Pricing** | Price per seat decreases with more seats | Tiered price: Standard $2 LCR → $1 LCR for 2‑seat, $0.8 for 4‑seat | | **Add‑ons & Extras** | In‑app purchase of extra seats or “kids” license | Up‑sell within Family Pack page | **Customer‑journey Example (South Asia)** 1. **User A** signs up for *Premium* (₹500/month). 2. **User A** invites **User B** (family member) via QR. 3. **User B** signs up using the same payment wallet → *Family Pack* activation, new price: ₹800/month (deemed 1.6× Premium). 4. Each user receives *one* device token; only 4 tokens allowed. > **Rationale**: Encourages household adoption; reduces churn of one‑seat users. --- ## 6. Forecasting Unit Economics | Metric | Target (by 2027) | How We’ll Hit It | |--------|-----------------|------------------| | **Average Revenue per User (ARPU)** | $3–$4 USD (incl. local currency) | Tier‑mix optimisation, upsell to Premium via targeted campaigns | | **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** | <$2 USD | Lower CPM on mobile‑money ads, referral programme via “family‑share” | | **Lifetime Value (LTV)** | >$12 USD | 9‑month churn < 10 % (benchmark), 5‑seat households ~ $20 LTV | | **CAC / LTV Ratio** | <0.2 | Continuous optimisation of partner‑deal pipelines (mobile‑network revenue share) | | **Gross Margin** | >60 % | Content cost amortised via multi‑seat packs, localisation of ads | **Example Calculation – Africa** *Standard Tier – $2 LCR (≈$0.3 USD)* - Monthly revenue ≈ $0.30 - Avg. 6 months subscription (Churn 15 %) → $1.8 USD LTV - CAC via mobile‑money ad = $0.6 USD → CAC/LTV = 0.33 *Family Pack – $8 LCR (≈$1.2 USD)* - Monthly revenue ≈ $1.2 USD - Avg. 9 months subscription (Churn 8 %) → $10.8 USD LTV - CAC via referral = $0.4 USD → CAC/LTV = 0.037 > **Result**: Family Packs drive most of the margin while keeping CAC low. --- ## 7. Consolidated Economic Reporting (USD) *1. Monthly “Local‑Currency‑to‑USD” Conversion* - Use the *mid‑month* spot rate. - Add a **hedging buffer** of +2 % to account for FX volatility for the next 30 days. *2. Price‑Indexing* - Compute *Local Price Index* (LPI) for each tier in each market. - Benchmark against competitor LPI and adjust by ±5 % quarterly to stay competitive. *3. Weighted Consolidated ARPU* \[ \text{Consolidated ARPU}_{USD} = \sum_{m} \frac{Revenue_{m}}{ActiveUsers_{m}} \] where \(m\) is the region. *4. Consolidated LTV* - Compute LTV per region using local churn and retention. - Convert to USD using same FX rate; apply a *regional discount factor* (e.g., 0.95 for high‑risk regions) to reflect higher churn risk. *5. Investor Dashboards* - **KPIs**: Consolidated ARPU, CAC/LTV, Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Churn Rate, Gross Margin. - **Segment View**: Tier mix, Payment‑rail mix. - **Risk View**: FX exposure, payment‑fraud incidents, regulatory alerts. > *By keeping these metrics transparent and regionally de‑aggregated, we satisfy investor demands for accountability while protecting the global unit economics.* --- ## 8. Implementation Roadmap (18‑Month Horizon) | Quarter | Milestone | Owner | Key Deliverables | |---------|-----------|-------|------------------| | **Q1** | Regulatory & Payment‑Rail Audits | Legal Ops & Pay‑Tech Partners | Completed compliance matrix, partnership contracts | | **Q2** | Local Pricing & Tier Definitions | Global Pricing Lead | LCR pricing table, tier mix projections | | **Q3** | Pilot Launch (3 Markets – 1 Africa, 1 SA, 1 LATA) | PMO, Regional Ops | Roll‑out kit, KPI dashboards | | **Q4** | Pilot Review & Optimization | Data Analyst, PMO | Adoption curves, churn data, pay‑rail success rates | | **Q1 (Year 2)** | Scale to 8 additional markets | Global Roll‑out Lead | Training, marketing pack | | **Q2** | Introduce “Family‑Share‑Wallet” | Product & Security | Smart‑card API, UI, security vetting | | **Q3** | Global Consolidated Dashboard Go‑live | BI & Finance | Investor‑ready financial reports | | **Q4** | Continuous Iteration (Price, Tiers, Renewals) | Pricing & Growth Teams | Price‑elasticity tests, renewal‑prompt automation | --- ## 9. Risk & Mitigation Matrix | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Monitoring | |------|------------|--------|------------|------------| | **Cross‑border Sharing** | Medium | High | Device/IP tokenisation, 15‑minute “cool‑down” | Quarterly audit of token logs | | **Regulatory Shifts (e.g., taxation on entertainment)** | Low | Medium | Pre‑emptive liaison with local tax advisors | Annual review | | **FX Volatility** | Medium | Medium | FX hedging + buffer + price‑indexing | Monthly FX variance alert | | **Payment‑failures (default, bounce)** | High | High | Multi‑rail fallback, auto‑de‑activate on 3‑fail | 24‑hr escalation | | **Family‑Pack Abuse (simulated household)** | Low | High | AI‑based pattern detection (device‑token anomaly) | Real‑time dashboard | | **Ad‑block & “no‑ads” Demand** | Medium | Low | Offer Ad‑free tier, dynamic ad‑swap | Ad‑view CTR monitoring | --- ## 10. Investor Communication Plan | Element | Message | Visual Aid | |---------|---------|------------| | **Strategic Rationale** | Localization protects 60 % of the projected user base; prevents “one‑price‑fits‑all” back‑fire | Heat‑map of world income vs. subscription readiness | | **Unit Economics** | Consolidated LTV > $12 USD, CAC < $2 USD, Gross Margins > 60 % | KPI bar chart: CAC & LTV trends | | **Risk Management** | FX hedging + payment‑rail diversification; regulatory compliance | Risk matrix + contingency plan | | **Growth Projections** | Tier‑mix model predicts 30 % of users to move to Family Pack in 2 years | Cohort‑flow diagram | | **Strategic Milestones** | 18‑month launch cadence; first 4‑market pilot | Gantt chart with key deliverables | --- ### Bottom Line *Localized pricing*—anchored in regional consumption willingness and payment habits—enables the company to capture high‑value segments in each growth market while maintaining a robust global economy that satisfies investors. By combining **dynamic tiering**, **payment‑rail flexibility**, **controlled family‑sharing**, and **transparent consolidated reporting**, the streaming service can: 1. **Maximise ARR** from low‑income, high‑volume markets without compromising margins. 2. **Drive household adoption** through the Family‑Pack, turning single users into multi‑seat revenue generators. 3. **Protect unit economics** via precise CAC‑to‑LTV calibration and fraud‑aware payment architecture. 4. **Deliver confidence to stakeholders** with a clear, data‑driven, and regulatable revenue‑model that scales internationally. These strategic levers, executed in the phased roadmap, will position the company for sustainable, investor‑backed growth across Africa, South Asia, and Latin America.
